description: This Java source file defines the `EntitySyncContext` class, which manages the state and process logic for synchronizing entity data between systems within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initializing synchronization contexts, assembling data to be synchronized (create, update, delete), handling transaction management, error reporting, and running synchronization processes such as push start, send data, and finalization.

classes.name: EntitySyncContext
classes.description: A class that provides context and methods for synchronizing entity data across systems within Apache OFBiz. It manages synchronization state, orchestrates data assembly (create, update, delete), handles transaction control, and updates sync status and history records.

methods.name: EntitySyncContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the synchronization context, retrieves EntitySync record, sets up timing, and prepares list of entities to process.

methods.name: isEntitySyncRunning
methods.description: Checks whether the synchronization process is currently active based on run status and last update time.

methods.name: hasMoreTimeToSync
methods.description: Determines whether additional synchronization passes are needed based on current timing.

methods.name: setCurrentRunEndTime
methods.description: Calculates and updates the end time for the current synchronization run segment.

methods.name: getNextRunEndTime
methods.description: Calculates the timestamp marking the end of the current run segment based on split configuration.

methods.name: advanceRunTimes
methods.description: Moves the current run window forward to prepare for the next segment.

methods.name: createInitialHistory
methods.description: Creates the initial synchronization history record, marking the start of a sync process.

methods.name: assembleValuesToCreate
methods.description: Gathers entities that have been inserted in the specified time window for synchronization, sorted by transaction and record timestamps.

methods.name: assembleValuesToStore
methods.description: Gathers entities that have been updated in the specified time window for synchronization, sorted similarly.

methods.name: assembleKeysToRemove
methods.description: Identifies primary keys of entities that have been deleted in the relevant timeframe for removal.

methods.name: saveResultsReportedFromDataStore
methods.description: Records synchronization outcomes such as counts of created, updated, and deleted entities into sync history.

methods.name: saveFinalSyncResults
methods.description: Marks the synchronization process as complete, updating sync status and optionally cleaning up history if no changes occurred.

methods.name: makeEntityNameToUseSet
methods.description: Creates a set of entity names that are part of this sync process.

methods.name: makeEntityModelToUseList
methods.description: Prepares the list of entity models that will be processed, considering inclusion rules and configurations.

methods.name: getCurrentRunStartTime
methods.description: Determines the start time for the current sync pass, based on last successful sync or earliest entity timestamp.

methods.name: saveSyncErrorInfo
methods.description: Logs synchronization errors in status and history records.

methods.name: runPushStartRunning
methods.description: Initiates push synchronization, marking status as running and creating initial history record.

methods.name: setTotalRowCounts
methods.description: Updates total counts of entities to be created, stored, or removed for reporting and control.

methods.name: runPushSendData
methods.description: Sends assembled data to a target sync service, handling errors and aggregating counts.
